headline_results.quote: There is a deterministic exact-rational algorithm that terminates and emits a two-layer ReLU network of hidden width at most max(0, n − 1), with affine output, satisfying f(x_i) = y_i for every i.
Its executable test suite exercises 144 finite contracts spanning one to twelve distinct points, one to four input dimensions, and one to three output dimensions.
It reports 1,824 precommitted next-token winner forecasts at four edit sites and 456 positions, all agreeing with the realized winner under the study's matching criterion.
among 96 arithmetic prompts, the baseline obtained 47 complete answers, a selected 128-weight deletion obtained 50, and the continuous rank-one intervention obtained zero.
When it exists the unique minimum-G-norm edit is u* = G^{-1} A^T M^+ c

notes_for_survey: Theoretical monograph framing WSP as a constrained inverse problem (expressibility, reachability, synthesis, verification) with a constructive exact ReLU compiler for finite contracts. Its only pretrained-model evidence is a transcribed Qwen3 study where next-token forecasts matched but complete-response acceptance failed; formal Lean verification is stated as outstanding. Internal inconsistency: Theorem 11 states width at most n, Theorem 20/abstract state n - 1.
